cache: Fresh transport for each measured UI run; no persistent extension result cache. Browser language packs ready. Browser internal caches and server prompt caches unchanged. Current code has a bounded per-page native-only result cache, not reused across these runs.
uiScope: Production PageTranslator and BrowserTranslationTransport injected into real GitHub pages, with scrolling and DOM display. Localhost production provider via Node bridge; not installed-extension IPC.
limits: Measured fast path requires the browser Translator API and ready language packs.
Firefox and unsupported browsers fall back to the configured model; no under-30-second result claimed there.
Headless Chromium language-pack preparation hung in one live extension run. A 20-second preparation deadline and fallback were added and tested.
Different measurement layers and page shells are not a controlled speedup ratio.
Three UI runs do not establish P95 or a universal latency guarantee.
